citations.claim: energy grows monotonically with no collisions or controller work
first energy_bound violation: energy exceeds allowed limit
body in free fall, vertical speed magnitude growing under gravity

counterfactual.change: Set gravity from 9.81 to 0 with all else identical; free-fall energy gain disappears and no violation occurs, showing gravity integration is the source.

explanation: Single body in free fall with no walls and disabled controller gains energy every step (E0~1656.8 -> 1698.3 -> 1741.2 -> 1785.3 -> 1830.8) until exceeding E0*1.1+5 at step 4. With vx constant and |vy| growing under gravity, semi-implicit Euler adds more kinetic energy than potential loses, especially at high speed (~57-60) with coarse dt~0.021. Gravity=0 counterfactual holds energy exactly constant, confirming integrator energy creation, not collisions or controller work, is the cause.
vision_note: A single blue body moves steadily downward in an empty arena with no walls, collisions, or waypoints visible. There is no obvious penetration, tunneling, or sudden jump, just smooth free-fall motion.
